description: Zombie Master: Reborn complete multiplayer content

sources.instructions: Stage the official Zombie Master: Reborn Beta 6 Linux archive, zombie_master_reborn_b6_1.tar.gz, linked from the project page. That build matches Steam app 244310 on the previous2021 branch. Copy the complete zombie_master_reborn/ tree, including every multiplayer map, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. The map sentinel does not prove completeness.

manual_reason: Manual full-distribution staging is required. These known file sentinels do not establish completeness; inspect the game-specific source instructions.
